title: Per-domain calibration packs and sampling strategy for FP8/INT8 quantization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, production-ready process and set of per-domain calibration packs for FP8 and INT8 quantization. The goal is to ensure quantized model variants maintain customer-visible quality across the major product domains (chat, docs summarization, search reranking, code completion). This ticket covers dataset curation rules, sampling algorithms, coverage metrics, versioning, and a validation/acceptance gate before rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Define per-domain pack composition and naming convention
Implement sampling pipeline that produces deterministic calibration packs from production logs
Automated accuracy validation harness that runs delta checks against baseline FP32 and flags regressions > 0.5% (configurable)
Publish calibration pack metadata (version, coverage stats, token-length distribution, intent distribution) to S3 and Console
Document runbook for producing a new pack and running the calibration + validation pipeline
proposal: We will produce small, medium, and large calibration packs per domain: sample counts targeted at 1k/10k/100k prompt samples respectively. Sampling will be stratified by 'intent cluster' (derived from embeddings of prompt + context), token-length buckets, and recent traffic recency weighting. Deduplication and near-duplicate suppression will be applied with a similarity threshold (cosine >= 0.92) to avoid calibration bias toward frequent templates. For low-volume domains we will fall back to cross-domain aligned packs. Calibration packs are immutable after release; new versions get semantic versioning (vYYYYMMDD+patch).
calibration_workflow_steps: Ingest production prompts via anonymized log export (PII removal stage) — daily export to staging S3
Preprocess: normalize whitespace, mask user-specific tokens, truncate long contexts per model max_seq policy
Embed prompts with model-lite encoder and cluster to form intent groups
For each domain and pack size: stratified sampling across clusters + length buckets + recency weight
Deduplicate using locality-sensitive hashing + final cosine check
Generate calibration input files (JSONL) and compute summary stats (coverage, entropy, token histogram)
Run quantization calibration pass (per-tensor activation range collection) and produce quantized candidate
Validation: run accuracy and regression suite, compute metrics and delta to FP32 baseline
If metrics pass acceptance, publish pack metadata and tag quantized artifact for rollout; otherwise iterate
sampling_algorithm: Primary approach: stratified reservoir sampling per (domain, intent_cluster, token_length_bucket) with recency-decay weights (w = exp(-lambda * age_days)). Use reservoir to ensure deterministic selection across daily pipeline runs by seeding with pack version + domain. For edge clusters with low volume (< 50 examples) perform cluster merging heuristics (merge closest in embedding-space) to preserve diversity. After selection, run LSH dedupe and remove near-duplicates (cosine >= 0.92). For long-tail prompts, apply importance oversampling using an estimator of per-cluster model sensitivity from a small probing pass (higher sensitivity => upweight).
examples_of_domain_packs: chat_small_v20251106: 1k samples, balanced across intents (greeting, instruction, follow-up, refactor), token-length 8-512
summarization_medium_v20251106: 10k docs, stratified by source type (email, articles, notes) and summary length buckets
code_completion_large_v20251106: 100k snippets, sampled by language, completion length, and API-surface usage frequency
rerank_small_v20251106: 1k queries, includes positive/negative pairs derived from logs + synthetic hard negatives
evaluation_plan: Run automated validation pipeline comparing quantized candidates (FP8/INT8) against FP32 baseline across these axes: exact-match/ROUGE for summarization, chat-turn BLEU/ROUGE+human spot checks, perplexity shifts, and a specialized code-safety correctness harness for completions. Define pass thresholds: mean metric delta <= 0.5% and 95th percentile latency improvement > 10ms for INT8. Record per-sample failures and surface top regression clusters to model team. If >0.5% regression, block release and create follow-up ticket for model calibration tweaks or sampling adjustments.
risks_mitigations: Risk: calibration packs overfit to templated prompts from high-traffic customers -> Mitigation: aggressive deduplication + downweighting by identical-hash frequency
Risk: privacy leakage during dataset curation -> Mitigation: PII scrub step enforced in preprocessing (regex + heuristics) and sampling only uses anonymized representations
Risk: skewed domain coverage due to recent event spikes -> Mitigation: cap recency weight contribution and include a stable historical reservoir (30d window)
Risk: nondeterminism in sampling -> Mitigation: deterministic seeding and CI checks that pack hashes remain stable given same inputs
